name: Linette Etheredge
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: As an integrated therapist, Dr. Linette Etheredge draws on evidence and trauma informed approaches to meet your individual needs and goals. As we gently attend to any grieving or tender parts of self, you’ll be supported to foster a more compassionate and intimate relationship with yourself and in time, experience more satisfying intimate connections with others. In our practice, we welcome people from all backgrounds, abilities, sexual preference, gender identity and relationship structures while supporting adults and young people aged 12+ to feel better, make changes and live their best lives!

name: Madonna Keightley
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I’m a counsellor in private practice, and I specialise in working with women who have experienced betrayal, including infidelity, compulsive sexual behaviour, and pornography addiction in their partner. I’m certified through APSATS and bring not only professional training but also lived experience of betrayal in my own marriage. Through my practice, Beyond Betrayal Counselling, I offer online support to women across Australia and internationally.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Shaun McMahon
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Shaun is a warm, caring and calm psychotherapist who works with both individuals and couples. He is passionate about helping his clients to overcome their challenges and to live more fulfilling lives, while offering a compassionate and comforting presence. He has a special interest in working with clients who have experienced trauma, including childhood trauma, relationship trauma and sexual trauma, as well as individuals with Borderline Personality Disorder.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery

name: Phyllis Traficante
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am the co-founder of Restoring Resilience training organisation; I am also a Gestalt psychotherapist, somatic experiencing practitioner, counselling supervisor and trainer. I provide psychotherapy for individuals, teens and families; I deliver the 'Tuning Into Teens’ parenting program developed by Melbourne University; mindfulness programs for youth; individual and group supervision for counsellors. My practice is grounded in relational philosophy and informed by Somatic Experiencing, Gestalt, Mindfulness and Psychodynamic ideas and practices.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy
